newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan overseas ship orders rise sharply in Feb.
newsitem.headline: Japan overseas ship orders rise sharply in Feb.

text.p: Foreign ship orders placed with Japanese shipyards in February surged 371.1 percent from a year earlier to 1.4 million gross registered tons (grt), an industry body said on Monday.
"The sharp rise reflects four orders received for very large crude carriers (VLCC) and is just coincidental," said a spokesman for the Japan Ship Exporters' Association.
Orders for February included three freighters, 11 bulk carriers, eight tankers and two refrigerated cargo carriers.
In the first two months of this year, Japan received export orders for 41 ships totalling 1.94 million grt, the association said.
